text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Mile Championship! This day has 
finally come!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! All that's left now is to run with 
everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! Before the race, I need 
to go greet Suzuka—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...No! Let's not do that after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka is my friend, but today, she is 
the rival I want to beat more than anyone 
else!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We can chat all we want after the race is 
over, yes!"
choice_data_list: Let's make this the best race ever!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Yeeess!! The one who will take victory in 
this race is me!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show Suzuka and Trainer a powerful 
dash that'll blow you both away!"
